title: Presidential candidates hit the campaign trail with town halls and street rallies on Tuesday
seoTitle: Presidential candidates active on Tuesday the 29th
subtitle: Town halls, interviews, street rallies, and meetings with supporters shaped the candidates' schedule
excerpt: On Tuesday (29), presidential candidates took part in town halls, gave interviews, held street rallies, handed out flyers, and met with supporters.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On Tuesday (29), the presidential candidates' schedule was filled with typical campaign activities. Highlights included participation in town halls and interviews with various media outlets.

Street campaigning

In addition to media appearances, candidates traveled to various locations, holding street rallies and handing out flyers. These actions aim to bring the campaigns closer to voters and directly share their platforms.

Meetings with supporters

The day also featured in-person meetings between the candidates and their supporters. These moments offer opportunities to strengthen alliances, listen to demands, and consolidate support bases.

Thus, Tuesday (29) reflected the intense campaign routine, combining media presence with street mobilization and direct dialogue with supporters.

With information from Agência Brasil.
